#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
task_root="${GENOS_DEV_ROOT:-$HOME/DEV}"
task_logs="$task_root/TRANSFER/db-log-rollback-r1/logs"
if ! mkdir -p -- "$task_logs"; then
  task_logs="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/8-agent-db-log-rollback-r1-$(id -u)"
  mkdir -p -- "$task_logs"
fi
task_log="$task_logs/$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)-$$.log"
exec > >(tee -a "$task_log") 2>&1
trap 'task_exit=$?; printf "DB_LOG_ROLLBACK_EXIT=%s LOG=%s\n" "$task_exit" "$task_log"' EXIT
printf "LOG=%s\n" "$task_log"
if [[ -n "${GENOS_PYTHON_DIR:-}" ]]; then export PATH="$GENOS_PYTHON_DIR:$PATH"; elif [[ -x /venv/bin/python3 ]]; then export PATH="/venv/bin:$PATH"; fi
python3 - --root "$task_root" "$@" <<'DB_LOG_ROLLBACK_PY'
import base64,hashlib,json,sys,types,zlib
raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(''))
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='f8b1ac23dfd235371d3b92eb091c97270345b94d11a454814f27ed1de26d9bb4'
bundle=json.loads(raw)
module=types.ModuleType('db_log_rollback')
exec(compile(base64.b64decode(bundle['code']),'rollback_db_logs.py','exec'),module.__dict__)
try:raise SystemExit(module.main(bundle['spec'],sys.argv[1:]))
except Exception as exc:
 print('DB_LOG_ROLLBACK FAILED: '+str(exc),file=sys.stderr,flush=True)
 raise SystemExit(1)
DB_LOG_ROLLBACK_PY
